Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Switch deploy to SFTP for Network Solutions compatibility

Network Solutions uses SFTP, not FTP. Replaced SamKirkland FTP action
with wlixcc SFTP-Deploy-Action and added a cleanup step to exclude
dev files from the upload.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Switch to lftp for SFTP deploy \(pure SFTP, no shell exec needed\)

Network Solutions blocks SSH exec commands. lftp uses the SFTP
subsystem directly for file transfers without needing shell access.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
